title: Aggregated derived data: edge-associated thermal patterns in Landsat surface temperature across land-cover classes in Paraná, Brazil (1985, 2002, 2024)
description: Aggregated derived data accompanying the article Edge-associated thermal patterns in Landsat surface temperature: magnitude, transition depth and directional contrasts across land-cover classes in Paraná, southern Brazil (Remote Sensing Applications: Society and Environment). Scene × polygon edge-minus-reference contrasts for the 150 m and 300 m windows, scene × polygon × neighbouring-class directional contrasts (DTEC), scene × polygon × distance-ring means for all thermal supports (30 m, 60–120 m box filters, PSF) and NDVI/NDMI, polygon attributes and the class-level results behind the figures and tables, for three Landsat year–sensor conditions (1985 L5 TM, 2002 L7 ETM+, 2024 L8/9 TIRS; 672 scenes) and MapBiomas Collection 10.1 land cover. The files reproduce the published point estimates and allow the crossed polygon × scene bootstrap to be recomputed without the Earth Engine extraction; verify_deposit.py checks this. The full scene × polygon × neighbouring class × distance-ring database is not included and can be rebuilt from public inputs with the code. See README.md.
